description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Settings, clearer titles:** Settings that looked like duplicates now say where they apply. No setting was changed, moved or reset.
  - **Quality menus:** "Shorts quality menu style" and "Timestamp quality menu style" replace the two similar "video quality menu type" titles.
  - **Toasts:** The toast switches say what they announce: "Show a toast when speed or pitch changes", "Show a toast when Shorts speed changes" and "Show a toast when quality changes (videos and Shorts)". The Shorts quality toast sits under its own heading.
  - **By place:** Speed dialog type (player button / Shorts), Settings button action (navigation bar / toolbar), Queue manager (player button / download action), Hide Previous & Next buttons (player / notification controls) and Custom playback speed menu type (video flyout).
  - **Flyout menus:** The two screens are named "Feed flyout menu" and "Player flyout menu".
  - **Headings:** New headings "Shorts video quality" and "Shorts playback speed", and "Playback", on the Video screen.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54** (no change).

Other languages keep the old titles until the translations are refreshed.

Not device-verified: other languages, and the toast rows are still never listed by the settings search (same as before).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.32.0...v1.32.1)
